description: Update a targeting attribute. Update a targeting attribute's type, allowed values, required flag, description, or SDK path. `name` is immutable.

description.description: Optional human note shown in the dashboard.

enum_values.description: Replacement allowed values (for `enum`), or `null` to clear.

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

required.description: Whether the attribute must be present on the evaluation context.

sdk_path.description: Optional dotted path the SDK reads the value from.

type.description: Declared value type of a targeting attribute.

name: release_flags_attributes_update
